answer_1.quote: Driven by recent advancements in LLMs' reasoning capabilities, a trend has developed in improving translation quality through a human-like decomposition-translation-refinement paradigm.
answer_1.outputs: translations from English into target languages at segment and paragraph levels

answer_2.quote: Following best practice, we use both reference-based and reference-free neural metrics, using COMET DA 22 and COMETKiwi-XL DA 23, respectively.

answer_3.quote: Explicit verification with an LLM-as-a-judge proceeds as follows: • Differentiation: LLM annotators are asked to identify the main pairs of differences, between translations t SS i and t TA i . • Attribution: LLM annotators are asked, for each element in the pair of differences v i between t SS i and t TA i , how many can be attributed to the decomposition step d i , giving trace-back counts c SS i and c TA i respectively
